messages:
sylvie: quick heads-up — ran a randomized-prefetch + 4-bit quant bring-up on llama4t-mini on a small canary. Observed ~1.9x p50 decode speed, nice, but saw a weird drop in pairwise winrate vs baseline on dialog prompts (~3.7% absolute). attaching short logs and a config snippet.

rohan: can you drop the exact config and the sample that failed? was this using deterministic seeds? :thinking:

sylvie: not deterministic, this was an early stochastic sweep. config: ```
model: llama4t-mini
quant: gptq-q4_0
speculative: 
  warmup_len: 16
  prefetch_prob: 0.18
  late_binding: true
sampling: 
  top_k: 50
  temp: 0.8
  seed: random
```. sample example where quality dropped: "How do I reset my router?" -> baseline helpful answer vs short, partially hallucinated answer from canary.

yuki: saw similar when we did high prefetch prob earlier — my hypothesis: stochastic prefetch increases variance in KV cache state for early tokens, which interacts badly with sampling temp >0 leading to more off-path tokens. I have trace showing kv-cache-miss spikes: ```
[2026-02-14 16:02:31] kv_cache_miss: 120/1024
[2026-02-14 16:02:33] kv_cache_miss: 680/1024
[2026-02-14 16:02:35] kv_cache_miss: 44/1024
```

chris: interesting — could also be quantization noise amplifying marginal token-prob differences so sampler picks worse tokens more often. 4-bit GPTQ on small models can shift logits a bit. we should separate sampling nondet vs quantization error. quick reproducibility plan: (1) run with seed fixed and temp=0 (greedy) to isolate quant effects, (2) run with full precision / no quant to isolate quant impact, (3) run with prefetch_prob=0 to isolate speculative-prefetch.

jamal: agree. propose evaluation harness: 1k heldout multi-turn prompts (~dialog / instruction mix), measure: pairwise preference winrate (human or LLM preference), PPL delta, and a targeted safety/incorrectness checklist. compute weighted regression score where winrate has 50% weight, PPL 30%, safety 20%. threshold for rollback = >2% weighted regression.

rohan: I'll run (1) and (3) today on the same hardware. can you, yuki, add an instrumented trace with KV metrics + RNG seed dumps so we can replay exact request IDs? deploy-bot, spin a job? :pray:

deploy-bot: started job job-5224713-canary-triage on cluster-3 (nodes=4, gpus=8). logs at http://ci.internal/jobs/job-5224713-canary-triage

yuki: added trace hooks and a small script to replay by request ID. dropping seed dump in the job artifacts. will also run full-precision baseline on one node.

chris: if we confirm quant is the root cause, try group-wise finer-granularity quant (per-channel) or q5* modes to reduce logit drift. also consider reducing prefetch_prob to 0.05 and increasing warmup_len to 32 as a mitigation.

sylvie: action items: rohan = run deterministic + no-prefetch runs; yuki = add traces + full-precision baseline; chris = enumerate quant configs to try (q5, per-channel, GPTQ+remap). jamal = prepare evaluation harness and compute weighted regression. we'll reconvene after job completes. :white_check_mark:

rohan: ETA ~3h. I'll post numeric winrates and PPL deltas in this thread.

sylvie: thanks — if regression reproduces on deterministic runs we rollback the canary and file a regression ticket. otherwise, we tune quant / prefetch. :thumbsup:
